text: The Goa Money Lenders and Accredited Loan Providers Act, 2013. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201323 Act Number: 23 Enactment Date: 2013-10-15 Act Year: 2013 Short Title: The Goa Money Lenders and Accredited Loan Providers Act, 2013. Long Title: To amend and consolidate the law relating to money lending in the State of Goa and or matters connected therewith and incidental thereto. Whereas it is expedient to make provisions for protecting the interests of borrowers, for regulating the transactions of money lending and for securing more transparency in such transactions in the State of Goa.
